newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares close lower, blue chips lead fall.
newsitem.headline: KL shares close lower, blue chips lead fall.

text.p: Share prices closed lower led by blue chips which gave back all of Friday's gains on profit-taking, dealers said.
They said with nothing to encourage the market, the Dow's 33-point drop on Friday provided the only lead.
Blue chips surged on last-minute buying on Friday, linked to the expiry of spot-month Composite Index futures contract.
Secondary stocks also turned softer in the afternoon as profit-taking set in.
The benchmark Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Composite Index ended at 1,106.20, down 12.37 points or 1.11 percent.
The index fall was exaggerated by an 18.9 percent drop in Nestle to 20.20 ringgit. The stock was one of the big gainers on Friday.
The Second Board index ended down 0.62 point at 536.46 after hitting a high of 542.00 in the morning.
Heavyweights Telekom Malaysia, Sime Darby, Genting and Resorts World fell between 25 and 40 cents each.
Newly listed Teck Guan closed at 8.70 ringgit against an offer price of 2.30 ringgit.
Market volume was 170 million shares, with losers leading gainers 383 to 177. -- Syed Azman (603-230 8911)
